AppMain+4 restart flag: only AppMain::update_frame clears it; the setter is not identified (probably a std::function lambda captured by AppPlatform). If it ever fires, update_frame runs AppMain::vf1 which destroys and recreates MinecraftGame (cached game pointers become stale).

MinecraftGame::update (vf22) may call sub_12dee0 -> sub_134d40 (device re-init) which calls AppPlatform_Winrt::vf143 (0x583b94) copying owner+0x94/+0x98 into platform+0x330/+0x334; the gfx area should keep owner+0x94/+0x98 equal to the client size or the platform size would revert after such an event.

HIDController::update polls CoreWindow::GetAsyncKeyState for VK 1,2,0x12,0x20 each frame (slot 20); the fake returns 0. Whether returning 0 for the mouse buttons has side effects vs. host-injected MouseItems is for the input area to confirm.
